repos_data.description: Tamper-evident audit log for Go: an append-only, hash-chained, optionally Ed25519-signed log/slog handler, with offline logx verify. Built on the standard library, zero third-party dependencies. Also a full slog toolkit (colored output, JSON, rotation, fan-out, CLI).

TypeScript SDK + MCP server for Tersign, the record layer for the machine age — counter-signed EIP-712 receipts, hash-chained action and disclosure records, refunds, disputes, venue-formatted evidence envelopes. npm: tersign
